Anthropic filed for an initial public offering in what could become one of the largest stock market debuts in history. 

What does Anthropic’s chatbot, Claude, think about the big IPO? CNN's David Goldman asked. https://t.co/ZKsjGnKnhj

A Swiss woman being treated for Ebola in Nigeria was medically evacuated to Switzerland with her husband, officials said. 

Nigerian authorities have continued monitoring 52 people who had been in contact with her. https://t.co/00WvIMamPt

Months after immigration agents shot and killed Alex Pretti in Minneapolis, his parents are accusing the Department of Justice of violating a federal victims' rights law as they demand transparency and justice in their son's death. https://t.co/OomwLgry4h https://t.co/yHCXx5Lhyw
